title: Joint Base Charleston, interagency partners establish ISB for hurricane relief efforts - No Graphics
description: Joint Base Charleston and interagency partners including the Federal Emergency Management Agency stood up an installation support base at Naval Weapons Station - Charleston. The ISB acts as a staging area for goods and commodities destined for Puerto Rico in response to the devastating effects of Hurricane Maria. JB Charleston is an ideal location for the ISB because of it's transportation capacity and capability to move relief supplies by air, land and sea.
keywords: US Army Reserve, Naval Weapons Station, relief, Joint Base Charleston, U.S. Transportation Command, 841st transportation battalion, USTRANSCOM, Hurricane Maria, U.S. Transportation Detachment, Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, Charleston
